references.purpose: Claim classes, sequence-model dependencies, recovery denominators, controls, sensitivity, and applicability for fixed-backbone sequence design.
read_when: choosing model variants, masks, or sampling settings
interpreting recovery, likelihood, or structural self-consistency
comparing sequence funnels or claiming compatibility
references.evidence_boundary: Defines interpretation of recorded sequence-design evidence; sequence scores and recovery do not establish experimental folding, binding, expression, or function.
